Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Geo Throw Blanket, Soft and Stylish, 50" x 60", Ivory and Blue
Colors: IVORY/BLUE
Varying shades of blue/grey triangles on ivory give this blanket both modern and farmhouse touches. A cotton/acrylic blend makes it soft yet durable to snuggle under for a good night's sleep, or as a drape over a living room chair. 50" x 60" 50% Cotton 50% Acrylic Dry clean for best results Made in Portugal
